$comment: Pins the badger.github.io simulator the emulator runs the badge app in.
It is the MicroPython WebAssembly runtime the badger/home Badge Simulator
canvas uses (its web/BUILD_INFO.json names the same revision). The files are
fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com at this exact commit the first time
and cached, so a run is reproducible and works offline after that.
To update: pick a newer commit of badger/badger.github.io, change revision,
and run `node badge-app/tools/emulator/emulator.js` to check the app still runs.
